linear-equation-solve.enter: y = (left side) on one line and y = (right side) on the next, copied as written; a fraction such as x/4 is typed with /.
linear-equation-solve.read: The x-coordinate of the point where the two graphs cross (click it). That is the solution.
linear-equation-solve.fails: When the solution is a fraction, Desmos shows a rounded decimal: match it to the choices, or enter the fraction. If no crossing shows, zoom out before deciding there is none.

system-intersection-point.enter: Both equations exactly as given, one per line. There is no need to solve for y first.
system-intersection-point.read: The coordinates of the point where the lines cross (click it). Use the coordinate the question asks for.
system-intersection-point.fails: When the crossing is off screen, zoom out. When the coordinates are fractions, Desmos shows decimals: match them to the choices.
